cases.name: no_mode_is_usage_error
cases.skip_reason: GNU tar 1.35 exits 2 when no operation mode is given; the spec (02-conventions §3) uses exit 1 for usage errors. Known difference.

cases.name: unknown_option_is_usage_error
cases.skip_reason: GNU tar 1.35 exits 64 (EX_USAGE) for an unknown option; the spec (02-conventions §3) uses exit 1 for usage errors. Known difference.

cases.name: bzip2_unsupported
cases.skip_reason: agentcmd does not implement -j (bzip2); the spec lists it as an unsupported option error (exit 1). GNU tar reads the plain archive with -j only when bzip2 is installed.
